enabled.label: Enable one-time secrets
enabled.hint: Disabling the module refuses new secrets; existing ones stay readable until they end.

durations.label: Offered durations
durations.hint: How long a secret stays valid from its activation. Check at least one duration.

defaultDuration.label: Default duration
defaultDuration.hint: Preselected at creation. It must be one of the offered durations.

fileAllowed.label: Allow an attached file
fileAllowed.hint: A small file, encrypted in the browser, can go with the text. It is not scanned by the antivirus.

emailAllowed.label: Allow delivery by e-mail
emailAllowed.hint: The server sends the link to a recipient. Otherwise the author hands the link over.

emailRequiresPassphrase.label: Require a passphrase for e-mail delivery
emailRequiresPassphrase.hint: A secret sent by e-mail must be protected by a passphrase, to be passed on through another channel.

errors.defaultNotOffered: Choose a default duration among the offered ones.
errors.fileSize: Enter a size in MiB, from {min} to {max}.
errors.expressLimit: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

delete.title: Delete this secret?
delete.text: The secret of {creator} will be destroyed and can no longer be read. This cannot be undone.

express.intro: An express secret is a text shared through a single link, created without any authentication and encrypted in the browser: the server never reads it.

enabled.label: Allow anonymous express secrets
enabled.hint: Off by default. Once on, anyone who can reach the address of this entity can create secrets without signing in. API tokens allowed to create express secrets are not affected by this switch. If the operator sets TT_EXPRESS_SECRETS_DISABLED on the instance, the service stays closed whatever is chosen here.

reminder.text: Before opening this service, complete the legal notice of the entity with a contact for abuse reports, and its privacy policy: the IP addresses of the creators are kept for 12 months in the audit log.
reminder.link: Open the legal texts of this entity

perIp.label: Secrets per hour and per client address
perIp.hint: Anonymous creations allowed per IP address over the last hour, from {min} to {max}. Default: {def}.

perToken.label: Secrets per hour and per API token
perToken.hint: Creations allowed per API token over the last hour, from {min} to {max}. Default: {def}.

maxPending.label: Express secrets waiting at the same time
maxPending.hint: Live express secrets this entity may hold; once reached, anonymous creations are refused. From {min} to {max}. Default: {def}.

purge.title: Emergency purge
purge.intro: Deletes every live anonymous express secret of this entity, for example after a misuse. Express secrets created with an API token, one-time secrets and ended secrets are not touched. The anonymous mode stays as it is: untick it above to stop new creations.
purge.button: Delete all live anonymous express secrets
purge.confirmTitle: Delete all live anonymous express secrets?
purge.confirmText: Every live express secret created without authentication will be destroyed and its link will stop working. This cannot be undone.

lookup.title: Find a secret from its link
lookup.intro: Paste the link of a secret, for example the one an abuse report points to, to see its state. The part after the # (the key) is never sent, and the link is neither kept nor logged.
lookup.label: Secret link
lookup.hint: The full link, or the tts_ token alone.

errors.invalid: This is not a valid secret link: it must contain a token starting with tts_.
errors.notFound: No secret of this entity matches this link.
